outcome: Restore and validate directed tour-prerequisite storage and its reader on the prod-based auto-50-perc-off delivery branch, reusing compatible historical migration, service and tests. Given a checkout tour ID and configured directed relationships, return configuration status and prerequisite-tour IDs, preserving multiple prerequisites for later paid-purchase qualification at any one of them.
practical_value: Supplies the missing configuration boundary required for Taggable’s automatic 50% discount without changing existing checkout, search, recognition, pricing or payment behavior.
stopping_condition: Complete only when the resulting version and diff are retained and the actual restored migration and reader execute against current dependencies in an isolated database, passing all five selected cases while preserving existing tours and rows. Inspect target MySQL schema compatibility, distinguish inspection from actual MySQL execution, and explicitly record unresolved database limitations. A compatibility failure preventing the capability from working leaves restoration incomplete. Keep source inspection, historical-file access checks, isolated delivery-branch setup and minimal dependency adaptations within this job; preserve the other branch and its untracked work. Do not expand into qualification, code selection, checkout integration, UI, recognition changes, production configuration or deployment.
contribution: Removes the demonstrated prerequisite-storage and lookup gap on the assessed delivery baseline. This bounded capability enables later qualification; it does not establish same-person paid purchase, apply a discount or complete the overall delivery goal.
proof: Retain the source version, resulting diff, execution results and database-preservation observations. Execute the restored migration and reader using current product dependencies against an isolated database. Demonstrate B-to-A configuration returns B as configured with A; B-to-A and B-to-C preserve both prerequisites without implementing purchase qualification; an unconfigured tour returns unconfigured with no prerequisites; B-to-A does not imply A-to-B; and migration up/down creates/removes only the new relationship storage while preserving the existing tours table and recorded rows. Verify reader calls leave tour data unchanged. Record branch isolation and preservation of the other branch and untracked work, and inspect the diff for the allowed edit boundary and unchanged surrounding behavior. Report MySQL schema inspection separately from any actual MySQL execution and disclose database limitations. Historical cases are controlled examples, not production evidence; historical passing results do not replace fresh execution.
before_description: The assessed prod-based delivery baseline lacks the owner-required directed tour-prerequisite storage and reader. Historical implementation and five controlled SQLite cases provide reuse material, but compatibility with current dependencies and target MySQL has not been demonstrated.
before_quote: The assessed delivery baseline lacks this owner-required capability.
